prompt:
A study of the Moodle Learning Management system reveals that the average
response time has an exponential distribution with a mean of 3 seconds.
(a) What is the probability the response time exceeds 5 seconds?
(b) Given that the response time exceeds 5 seconds, what is the probability
the response time exceeds 10 seconds?
judge_reasoning: The correct probabilities are P(X>5)=e^{-5/3}≈0.1889 and P(X>10|X>5)=e^{-5/3}≈0.1889 due to the memoryless property. Candidate 1 uses the right expressions and gives the correct numeric approximation (~0.189) for both parts. Candidates 2–4 use the correct symbolic form but significantly miscalculate the numerical values (e.g., reporting e^{-5/3}≈0.2183 or 0.2231, and other incorrect approximations), making their answers incorrect.
